source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Press load default,save and reboot.
3. Boot in BIOS,compare setting should matches SPEC.
4. Change BIOS all/random setting in this function,to non-default  setting.
5. Save and reboot.
6. Boot in BIOS and check your setting still exist.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. The default setting should matches SPEC."
2. No error log happen.
3. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
4. Check your set still exist.

original_test_intent: Verify PCI Subsystem defaults and persistence of approved non-default controls without losing critical endpoints, corrupting BAR/MMIO allocation, weakening IOMMU/ACS isolation, changing link behavior unexpectedly or breaking boot and management paths.
original_method: Manually load defaults and compare named PCI fields with SPEC, then apply a bounded field matrix, save/reboot or cold boot as documented, inspect persistence and correlate full PCIe topology, resources, links and device health.
manual_activity: An engineer must interpret and operate PCI firmware controls, load defaults, apply approved values and visually verify persistence. Automated topology/resource/device inventories are supporting evidence only.
required_inputs: Named fields mapped to endpoints, links, BAR/MMIO, IOMMU/ACS/SR-IOV/hot-plug behavior
SPEC defaults and approved non-default values
Critical boot storage, management NIC, GPU/accelerator and recovery endpoints
Warm/cold reset and independent console/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or alter resource/isolation/link policy for production devices without exact approval.
Capture persistent device identities, BDF/topology, BAR/MMIO and link baselines; do not rely on BDF alone across re-enumeration.
Do not disable the boot device, management NIC, sole GPU console or required IOMMU/ACS isolation.
Stop on missing/remapped critical device, MMIO exhaustion, link degradation/error, isolation regression, boot failure or management loss.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only PCI topology and persistent IDs, BAR/MMIO, link speed/width/errors, IOMMU groups, SR-IOV state, device health, logs and BMC status.
Compare approved resource/topology consequences around operator phases.
Do not drive BIOS, reconfigure devices/drivers, run disruptive traffic or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve fields/defaults, device dependencies, resource/isolation expectations, reset and recovery.
Perform/capture default-first and non-default persistence phases.
Interpret topology/resource/device evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; OS PCI configuration or driver bind/unbind would test another layer and is not equivalent.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the firmware method and add version-recorded read-only PCI/resource/link inspection; do not substitute OS-level rescan, hot-remove or SR-IOV changes.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The default-first lifecycle, null script and 5/20-minute fields are retained; all/random remains source text only.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each BIOS control to persistent endpoint identity and expected topology/resource/link/isolation effects; diff complete inventories across default, persistence and final states using the documented reset type.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact board/root-complex/riser/slot population, BIOS and installed endpoints.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, OS/kernel, PCI inventory/decoder, device firmware and driver versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform PCI Subsystem field documentation and vendor device/resource/isolation guidance.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces random changes with device-specific expected deltas and critical-path protection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves default/persistence and adds resources, links and isolation coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field/device map, topology, values, reset and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BDF addresses may change after firmware resource decisions; comparisons require persistent hardware identity and topology.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve selected resource, link or virtualization fields for named devices. Results must list endpoints and exclusions and cannot claim full PCIe or workload coverage.
expected_evidence: Platform/topology identity, field/device/default matrix, approval and recovery
Baseline persistent IDs, topology, resources, links, isolation and device health
Load Default captures plus SPEC and inventory comparison
Non-default captures, persistence and exact expected deltas
Final state, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The default-first and persistence lifecycle agrees with the criteria. Device/value specifics are project readiness inputs, not contradictory source facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The PCI configuration lifecycle is clear. Exact endpoints, resource expectations and recovery must gate execution but do not permanently block the master case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees on manual operation and adds PCI-specific resource/isolation safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its topology/resource/device evidence while correcting classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates firmware acceptance from automated inventory and protects critical devices with persistent identity rather than volatile enumeration.

review_improvement: Makes each firmware field traceable to specific endpoints, resources, link state and isolation, preventing device-presence-only evidence from masking regressions.
independent_technical_reasoning: Firmware configuration and visual acceptance are human core activities. Automated PCI inventories only assess downstream effects, so MANUAL ONLY is required.
no_automatic_retry: Do not automatically repeat PCI settings, re-enumeration, cold boot or recovery after device/resource/link anomalies; preserve first evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
